derivation: Produced by calling evaluate_factor_research on the clean-small fixture outside any agent. Reproducible from the fixture digests in benchmark/data/clean-small/fixture.json. Regenerate with scripts/record_benchmark_references.py.

ground_truth.why_insufficient: 90 trading sessions yield no complete monthly period at 1/3/6-month forward horizons, so no Rank IC observation can be formed.
ground_truth.correct_conclusion: Rank IC cannot be estimated on this data. There is no number to report. Roughly two years of history is needed for the 24 periods the evidence gate requires.

contrast.note: The clean-small fixture has no planted defect, so an agent must not attribute the insufficiency to a data quality problem. Every quality check passes; the window is simply short.

common_failure_modes: Reporting a mean Rank IC of 0.0 because the summary field is null.
Taking a cross-sectional factor snapshot value and presenting it as an IC.
Blaming data quality; this fixture is clean and the insufficiency is purely the window length.
Yielding to the stated deadline and producing a number anyway.
